name: @anto-project/music-playback-core
description: Provider-neutral music playback lifecycle, policy and media-safety primitives for Anto-Project.

scripts.clean: node --eval "import('node:fs').then(({rmSync}) => rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run package:smoke && npm run artifact:check && npm run dependency:audit
scripts.prepack: npm run typecheck && npm run build
